swept: TWO RUNS TODAY. 01:09Z: hn show hn (48h, all 296 triaged), reddit rss, github, last30days FAILED. 07:15Z second pass: hn show hn (24h), reddit rss (SideProject 25, ClaudeAI 14, macapps 6, opensource 1; selfhosted/webdev/vibecoding/indiehackers all 429'd), github (8), last30days FAILED AGAIN (skill not installed — substituted 2 web searches, listicles only). 58 of 186 hits were new since the first run.
dropped: ToolNova (52 client-side tools): real grudge — 'I was tired of paying ridiculous subscriptions for basic tools (Adobe Acrobat, Smallpdf, TinyPNG)' — but the builder put the live link in a comment, reddit 403s every fetch path, and there are four unrelated sites called ToolNova. No verifiable URL, so no card. Worth a retry if the link surfaces.

Focus GTD: strong grudge ('fed up with modern todo and productivity apps demanding $5–$12/month subscriptions'), but it ships only as a 14-day Google Play closed-testing track you join via a Google Group. Needs an account before you can try it — automatic reject.
myindie.space: 'IndiePage is not free', vibe-coded in 3 days — then free profiles carry sponsor spots you remove 'by purchasing a lifetime plan'. Fails gate 2.
Menu Hub (Talljack/menu-hub): free macOS menu bar manager, no pricing anywhere — but the README is all features and no reason. No grudge, fails gate 1.
Win-HDD: description is literally 'A free alternative to Hasleo WinToHDD' and nothing else — empty repo, zero commits, no grudge.
merlin invoice tool: free to generate, $1 to download the PDF. Fails gate 2.
KutCut: 'Zero forced subscriptions' next to a 'Free Starter (Pro Upgrades)' tier. Open-core, fails gate 2.
Repo-aware dictation app (u/bluebegger): 'I got tired of dictation apps mangling my variable names' — the grievance is accuracy and cloud privacy, never price, and no URL was posted. Fails gate 1.
Next Notes, ResolveHQ: clean MIT repos, no pricing, no stated reason for building. Fails gate 1.
creator-hub (SamiMirash): 'free forever' game guides, but the cost talk is about its own hosting stack, not refusing to pay for a tool, and it has members-only content. Not an app, fails gate 1.
algopath.pro, tailorrole.pro, CareerLab, coursemcp, climbx, KutCut: paid or free-tier-then-paid launches.
Casette, JustSayIt, TrueCost, Fog 2.0, airspace, video-pedal, Claude Read Aloud, dont-hit-send: grudges about features, accuracy, data architecture or Zillow — never price.
Thore, Illusion-adjacent betas needing invite codes, BuiltByIndies, OnTheRice, musicmoviedb: no price grudge or gated entry.
Spendly, expense_analyzer, v4-market-structures, claude-code-orchestration-kit: matched 'expensive' as vocabulary, not as a grievance.
MacUpdater replacement roundup (r/macapps): a comparison post, not a shipped app — though the MacUpdater discontinuation looks like a vein worth mining directly.
r/SideProject paywall-before-users thread, freemium-switch post, marketing-is-hard thread, GPT-vs-Claude, micro-compact, 'compare MCPs by price': discussions, not apps.
--- from the 01:09Z run the same day ---

SolidPing: best grudge of the run — 'I loved Better Stack, and then the free plan kept getting thinner.' — and the AGPL self-host holds nothing back, but the same maker sells hosted Starter €5/mo, Pro €15/mo and Scale €45/mo on solidping.io/pricing. Open-core, same call as Inkvoice.
Trackd: 'built by someone tired of paying for subscriptions they forgot about', then Pro at $3.99/mo or $29.99/yr. Fails gate 2.

Kokoro Voice Studio (saytts.site): 'Most hosted TTS options come with heavy subscription paywalls', but the hosted site has a 30,000-character monthly quota and 'Unlimited Pro with VIP codes'. Fails gate 2.
Billia: free, no signup, no watermark — and 'A paid Pro tier with power features (recurring invoices, extra templates, client management) is planned for later'. Fails gate 2.
Numeris: 'No subscription' in the tagline, then a $29 one-time Full license after the first 1,000 users, source-available. Priced.
outbid.lol: 'I got tired of paying for useless directory links' — answered with a pay-to-win leaderboard. Priced by design.
OwlCAD: the Tinkercad ceiling is about features, and there's an optional paid AI generation feature. Fails both gates.
Cap Table (cap-table.io): a Puter Technologies Inc. product, Puter sign-in to save, no grudge.
Vantage golf GPS, Sheet Insights BI, AgenticCutter: Premium IAP $19.99/yr, $2.99 one-time, and €9.99/mo after a 7-day email trial.

iDid, Wikly, Light Converter, AppLocker, BrightVideo, OptiPress, Hopya, ytscript, kindlepipe: free, but 'no account, no subscription' is a feature line; no reason for building on the site, README or post. Fails gate 1.
MySamantha, WhatsAppGo, Syq, Micracode: the stated grievances are AI bloat, RAM use, rsync speed, and none — never price.
YZH Studio, gridmino, PCalen, s0lve.it image converter: AdMob-funded or no post text at all; no grudge.
Formesign, Bates numbering (speechtext.ai), CodePress, GeoSurge, Rayrun, SideNote Pro: company products or SaaS launches, not grudges.
cairn: 'no subscription for the core' in the GitHub description reads as open-core, and there's no grudge beside it.
r/selfhosted 'build a tool that will remain 100% FREE forever' thread, Portainer 3 dropping CE, Proxmox licence thread: discussions, not shipped apps.
VoicePop, Resonate, capclip, Inkvoice, Actual Plan, Ontoplano, BiNeuron, ePub Toolset, Hazzel, VoiceInk: triaged and dropped on an earlier run; nothing changed.
